items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Annie' is in the context of the song title 'Annie Don't Live Here No More' discussed by the interviewer and interviewee.

ctx.x: That we did, and he threatened, he's hit the piano, I won't do it! I won't do it! So the manager would come out. Now, Tom. Now, Tom. Especially Kirkpeby. Now Tom. And Thomas, now after all, but -- now, I -- for me. I think you should, and they would go through this business, you know. And he would say well, maybe so, all right, but he was --
Now for instance, I remember one tune, 'Annie Don't Live Here No More.'
